purpose: Source-disjoint frozen partitions for the patent-like corpus. Replaces the July train-pool index, which carried no identities, snapshots or strict flag.
output_dir: output/PatentVecSourcePartitions (Git-ignored; regenerate with the command below)

identity_rule.CAD-VGDrawing: CAD-VGDrawing:model:<model_id> (model, not view: the four sibling views of one CAD model cannot straddle a split)

scope: Release partitions are document/model disjoint; these sources may have been seen by historical pretraining.

verification.note: Ten sheets is a functional check that snapshot hashes verify and generation succeeds, not a statistically meaningful rejection-rate estimate.
